summary: ADR-0059 accepted 2026-08-18; valid published/LKG catalog may replay frozen selection against current read-set and yield validator-owned successor; knowledgeSelectionHash excludes bytes; knowledgeContextHash binds selection/current source hashes/snapshot/Locator/decisions/predecessor; authority envelope covers ADRs/rules/policies/contracts/registries/allowed successors; stale freshness or query-quality may allow degraded unrelated execution if selection/authority/modules/read-set verify; publication failure cannot advance current/LKG and preserves valid LKG consumption; selection/authority/contract/command-test/policy/protected-path/source-integrity/Knowledge self-change remain blocking or semantic-review; rapid profile: same-selection successor only, no Knowledge self-change/publication/lifecycle/authority replacement; production/release: current published Knowledge, publication-quality checks, applicable semantic evidence; extends ADR-0048/0050; supersedes only ADR-0057 stale-stop interpretation; publication query gate and LKG integrity unchanged.
